notes.title: Neverwards Demo 0.3.3 is now Live!
notes.notes: [p][b]Demo version 0.3.3 with many fixes/improvements is now Live to download & play![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This version is much more stable than previous versions You can view the full change log in game, we also fixed issues addressed by players in this version inculding a huge improvement to Dungeons & UI screens.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Thanks very much for playing Neverwards![/i][/p]
